title: GRUET: Quantifying Uncertainty of Agentic Reasoning-and-Acting Processes
abstract: arXiv:2609.24831v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agents have attracted considerably increasing attention due to the power of executing both Reasoning and Acting (ReAct) in open and dynamic environments. The ReAct process typically exhibits a multi-turn trajectory in which one drives Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate both reasoning chains and task-specific actions in an interleaved manner. However, agents often suffer from significant uncertainty, where identical tasks yield divergent trajectories; trajectories with higher uncertainty often produce incomprehensible behaviors, severely undermining agent credibility. This work conjectures that such trajectory-level uncertainty frequently stems from cumulative turn-level reasoning uncertainty induced by LLMs; the latter often exhibits a collection of branches of divergent reasoning chains and their resulting actions. Built upon this, we present the Graph-based Reasoning UncErtainty in Trajectories (GRUET) method for the uncertainty

translated_title: GRUET：量化智能体推理与行动过程的不确定性
translated_abstract: 智能体因其在开放和动态环境中同时执行推理与行动的能力而受到越来越多的关注。ReAct过程通常表现为多轮轨迹，其中驱动大语言模型（LLM）以交错方式生成推理链和任务特定的动作。然而，智能体常常面临显著的不确定性，即相同的任务会产生不同的轨迹；不确定性较高的轨迹往往会产生难以理解的行为，严重损害智能体的可信度。本工作推测，这种轨迹层面的不确定性通常源于LLM引起的累积的轮次级推理不确定性；后者通常表现为发散推理链分支及其相应动作的集合。基于此，我们提出了基于图的轨迹推理不确定性（GRUET）方法，用于量化不确定性
tldr: 提出了GRUET方法，通过将LLM引发的轮次级推理不确定性以图结构建模并累积，来量化智能体ReAct过程的轨迹级不确定性，从而提升智能体的可信度。
en_tdlr: Proposes GRUET, a graph-based method that quantifies trajectory-level uncertainty in agentic ReAct processes by modeling and accumulating turn-level reasoning uncertainty induced by LLMs, thereby improving agent credibility.
